system.description:
You have been chosen by a higher force or are a being from another realm. Your powers are a reflection of your calling or true form.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.8gElnEQXhh6n4OFV]{Command Power}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.wVeieBovAW6v346q]{Dangerous Explosion}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.cg94zciN04k88cCI]{Embolden}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.jOpQ4w5PydCkDhpF]{Resolve}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.G8G0KDjDTfRsVgQv]{Resilience}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.xqo2qx2qRIUiZRtH]{Twist Reality}
Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
